motion.title: Motion library
motion.sub: A short catalogue of motions — jogging, turning, sitting at a café — that the image-to-video engine turns an approved still into. Edit, rename, archive or add your own; nothing here generates anything yet.
motion.newD: A short key, a name in both languages, a motion hint for its category, and whether it is a group clip (cut together from separate clips, never one generated crowd shot).
motion.name: Name (English)
motion.groupClip: Group clip (two or three models together)
motion.confirmArchive: Archive this action? Nothing is deleted — restore it any time.

err.NOT_FOUND: Not found — the page may need a refresh.

videos.title: Videos
videos.sub: Turn one of your product's own live photos into a short clip. The clip always moves from an already-approved still — nothing is ever imagined from text.
videos.offNotice: Off today. Turn on "Image-to-video clips" in Settings before requesting a clip.
videos.newD: Pick a product with a live photo, the shape and the length, then price it before you ask for it.
videos.newDOff: Turn the switch on in Settings first.
videos.noProducts: No product has a live photo yet — add one in Products first.
videos.requested: Clip requested — queue it below when you're ready to run it.
videos.costUnset: Cost not set — ask the owner to set a rate in Settings

err.OFF: The video engine is off — turn it on in Settings first.
err.SOURCE_INVALID: This product has no live photo to move from yet.
err.WRONG_STATE: This job has already moved on — the page may need a refresh.
err.CAP_REACHED: This clip has already been tried its limit of times.
err.NOT_FOUND: Not found — the page may need a refresh.

hub.title: Studio
hub.sub: Your social accounts, your brand asset library, your post templates and what you've generated from them.
hub.note: Nothing here posts to a real account or spends anything. A generated post is a preview only today (your product's own existing photo) — the real compositor and real posting come in later PRs. A new account always starts off and needing approval.

err.NOT_FOUND: Not found — it may have been changed by someone else just now.
err.STALE: Someone changed this just now — the page is refreshing.
err.TEMPLATE_ARCHIVED: Restore the template before changing it.
err.NO_PRODUCTS: Pick at least one product to feature.
err.WRONG_STATE: This job already ran — refresh the page.
err.TOO_LARGE: The file is larger than the upload limit.
err.NOT_AN_IMAGE: That file is not a picture.
err.TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED: That kind of file is not accepted.
err.STILL_IN_USE: This file is still used by a template — take it off first.
err.forbidden: You don't have the permission for that.
err.network: Could not reach the server — check your connection.

accounts.d: One row per platform page/channel. A new one is always off and needs your approval before anything from it goes out.
accounts.externalIdPh: The page or channel's own id
accounts.namePh: A name for you to recognise it by
accounts.added: Account added — switched off and needing approval

templates.d: The shape a post takes once the render engine below fills it with your own photos.
templates.namePh: A name for you to recognise it by
templates.notesPh: Anything worth remembering about this template

assets.d: Your logo, overlay frame, intro/outro and royalty-free track. Kept apart from your product photos — never shown as one.
assets.needMedia: Uploading needs Media library access as well — ask the owner or a manager.

renders.d: Pick a template and the products to feature; queue it, then generate it. Today's result is a preview only — your product's own existing photo, not yet a real composite. Real video/image composition and posting come in later PRs.
renders.productsHelp: Paste one or more product ids, separated by commas. A product picker is coming in a later refinement.
renders.caption: Caption (optional)
renders.captionPh: Your own words — nothing here writes this for you yet
renders.noPhoto: None of this job's products has a live photo yet.
